admin_plugins_allowlist_description: Limit which hosts {name} can reach. Narrows the plugin's declared hosts; user-supplied server URLs (x-allowed-host) are unaffected.
admin_plugins_allowlist_empty: No hosts — every outbound request will be blocked.
admin_plugins_allowlist_warning: Plugin will make no network calls with this configuration. User-supplied server URLs (x-allowed-host) are unaffected.
admin_plugins_overview_caps_description: What this plugin can do. Global capabilities work without any connection. User capabilities require each user to connect their own account.
admin_plugins_overview_fallback_descript: When a user's request needs a {name} call, which credentials does the server try?
admin_plugins_overview_policy_off_desc: Admin and user keys stay separate. User-scoped calls use the user's own keys only.
admin_plugins_overview_policy_admin_firs: Try shared credentials first; fall back to the user's personal connection when exhausted.
admin_plugins_overview_policy_personal_f: Try the user's connection first; fall back to shared credentials if it fails or is missing.
admin_plugins_detail_not_found_descripti: No plugin with id {id} is currently registered.
admin_plugins_header_uninstall_warning: Uninstalling removes this plugin and all of its user connections.
admin_plugins_uninstall_description: This removes the plugin and deletes every user connection associated with it. Data on the external service is not affected. To confirm, type {name} below.
admin_plugins_header_dialog_description: Values are stored encrypted on the server and never displayed after save.
admin_plugins_header_dialog_field_name_r: To rename a header, delete and re-add it.
admin_plugins_header_dialog_error_invali: Invalid header name — use RFC 7230 token characters only.
admin_plugins_header_dialog_error_reserv: Header is reserved by the runtime.
admin_plugins_header_dialog_error_empty_: Value cannot be empty — use the delete action to remove.
admin_plugins_headers_description: Injected into every request {name} makes. Admin values override plugin-supplied headers on conflict. Values are encrypted on the server and never returned.
admin_plugins_list_description: Manage plugins that provide external service integrations. Toggle individual plugins, drill in to manage shared credentials, configuration, and security policy.
admin_plugins_list_empty_description: Built-in plugins register on server boot. If the list is empty, check the server logs for startup errors.
admin_plugins_list_no_matches_descriptio: Try a different filter or clear the search.
admin_plugins_install_dialog_description: Paste a manifest URL. Built-in plugins register on server boot; third-party plugin installs ship in a later version.
admin_plugins_install_dialog_sandbox_not: Remote install is disabled until the QuickJS sandbox is running.
admin_plugins_install_dialog_field_hint: Drop the plugin's plugin.json URL — relative asset paths resolve from it.
admin_plugins_config_description: Server-wide settings for {name}. Secret fields stay encrypted on the server and are never displayed after save — leave blank to keep the existing value.
admin_plugins_shared_creds_no_creds_titl: No shared credentials for this plugin
admin_plugins_shared_creds_no_creds_desc: {name} only exposes user-scoped capabilities. Each user must connect their own account from Settings → Connections.
admin_plugins_shared_creds_pool_descript: {enabled} of {total} active. The server rotates between enabled keys when one hits a rate limit.
admin_plugins_shared_creds_single_descri: {name} accepts a single shared key. Replace the existing entry rather than adding another.
admin_plugins_shared_creds_section_descr: Admin-owned pool. Users without their own connection still get global capabilities through these.
admin_plugins_shared_creds_capacity_tool: This plugin only supports one shared credential.
admin_plugins_shared_creds_empty_global_: Global-scoped capabilities will return CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE until one is added.
Global-scoped and user-fallback capabilities will return CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE until one is added.
admin_plugins_shared_creds_empty_user_fa: User-fallback capabilities will return CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE until one is added.
admin_plugins_shared_creds_delete_descri: This removes the credential from the pool. Capabilities that depend on it will return CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE until you add a replacement.
admin_plugins_shared_creds_dialog_descri: Stored encrypted on the server and never returned.
admin_plugins_shared_creds_dialog_label_: A short name so you can identify this entry in the pool.
admin_plugins_shared_creds_dialog_enable: Disabled entries stay in the pool but are skipped during rotation.
admin_plugins_shared_creds_dialog_keep_s: Leave secret fields empty to keep their existing value.
admin_plugins_fallback_policy_off_explai: Admin and user keys are kept separate. Global calls use the admin pool; user calls use the user's own keys only.
admin_plugins_fallback_policy_admin_firs: Admin-owned keys are tried first; users' own keys only kick in when the admin pool is exhausted for that call.
admin_plugins_fallback_policy_personal_f: Users' own keys are tried first; admin-owned keys only fill in when the user's pool is exhausted.
admin_plugins_fallback_policy_pure_globa: Only applies to plugins with user-scoped capabilities.
admin_plugins_security_description: Restrict the hosts this plugin can reach and inject extra headers into every outbound request. Enforced by the plugin runtime at the fetch boundary.
admin_users_description: Invite, assign roles, and manage user accounts.
admin_users_search_placeholder: Search users by name or email

match.role=role_admin: Full server access. Bypasses every permission check.
match.role=role_member: Standard user — personal connections, watchlist, requests, and feedback.
match.role=role_viewer: Read-only — can browse but not request, rate, or link external services.

admin_users_invite_drawer_subtitle: Send email invites or generate a shareable link. Invitees pick their password and land on Profile.
admin_users_invite_emails_hint: One per line, or separated by commas. Each invitee gets a 7-day link by email.
admin_users_invite_max_uses_hint: Once exhausted the link stops working. Pick 1 for a single-recipient link, or 0 for unlimited.
admin_users_invite_role_email_hint: Each invitee will be created with this role
admin_users_invite_role_link_hint: Anyone with this link signs up as
admin_users_detail_role_subtitle: Determines which areas of Nama this user can access.
admin_users_detail_role_self_lock: You can't demote yourself from admin while you are the only admin. Promote another user first.

match.countPlural=one: 1 active session across this user's devices.
match.countPlural=other: {count} active sessions across this user's devices.

admin_users_detail_danger_subtitle: Permanently deletes the account, sessions, watchlist, and feedback. This can't be undone.
admin_users_detail_confirm_delete_body: Permanently removes the account, all sessions, watchlist, requests, and feedback. {email} won't be able to sign back in.
admin_users_detail_confirm_sessions_body: Every active session for this user is revoked. They'll need to sign in again from scratch.
admin_roles_description: Define what users with each role can do.
admin_roles_group_system_hint: Built-in. Can't be deleted or renamed.
admin_roles_group_custom_hint: Defined for this server. Edit, duplicate, or delete.
admin_roles_seed_admin_description: Full server access. Bypasses every permission check.
admin_roles_seed_member_description: Standard user — personal connections, watchlist, requests, and feedback.
admin_roles_seed_viewer_description: Read-only — can browse but not request, rate, or link external services.
admin_roles_seed_curator_description: Member who can also approve and deny requests from the queue.
admin_roles_detail_system_notice: System roles are seeded by the server and can't be edited or removed. Duplicate this role to use it as a starting point for a custom role.
admin_roles_detail_permissions_subtitle_: Admin bypasses every permission check in code. The list below is read-only.
Toggle individual permissions, or whole scopes via the scope header.
admin_roles_detail_members_section_empty: No users currently have this role.
admin_roles_detail_confirm_delete_body_e: No users have this role, so this is safe.

match.countPlural=one: 1 user will be moved to "Member" before this role is deleted.
match.countPlural=other: {count} users will be moved to "Member" before this role is deleted.

admin_roles_scope_media_description: What users can do with content — browse, request, react.
admin_roles_perm_media_discover_descript: Home feed, search, and external browsing.
admin_roles_perm_media_details_descripti: Open detail pages — overview, cast, trailers.
admin_roles_perm_media_activity_descript: View own watch and request history.
admin_roles_perm_media_feedback_descript: Rate, react, and leave notes on titles.
admin_roles_perm_account_connections_des: Link personal media-server and metadata accounts.
admin_roles_perm_account_profile_descrip: Edit own profile, password, and notifications.
admin_roles_perm_admin_users_description: Invite, assign roles, suspend, and remove accounts.
admin_roles_perm_admin_requests_descript: Approve, deny, or escalate any user's request.
admin_roles_perm_admin_jobs_description: Trigger, pause, and inspect background jobs.
admin_jobs_trigger_dialog_schedule_bypas: This will immediately start a new run of {jobId}, bypassing its schedule.
admin_jobs_run_detail_logs_empty_descrip: This job run has no logs.
admin_jobs_run_detail_logs_truncated_des: {count} log entries were truncated because the buffer exceeded its limits.
